paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
notes: Cosmological bounds on ALPs with two-photon coupling g (GeV^-1) vs mass in the mphi-g plane (Fig 1). Coupling type clearly AxionPhoton. However, the exclusion contours (Neff, BBN D/He, EBL, CMB mu/y, xion, DM, etc.) are presented only as plots/regions without tabulated numerical (mass, g) pairs. No reliable digitizable data points could be extracted from text. One approximate boundary relation given: g/GeV^-1 >~ 1e-3*(eV/mphi)^1.5 (low-mass edge of Neff bound). DM line: mphi=154 eV accounts for all DM. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionPhoton (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
